name: Collar
long_description:
Traction in just 2 months: 
$372K anualized revenue
>30 clients including Fortune 500, NYSE and NASDAQ-listed companies.
6X month over month revenue growth across multiple five-figure monthly enterprise contracts

Multi-billion-dollar companies still run investor relations on excel sheets and word docs. Hunting down the right investors. Recounciling thousands of documents for earnings calls. Surviving hours of investor Q&A.

Collar lets one IR VP do the work of a whole team. Our proprietary citation-backed AI harness automatically targets investors, reconciles data across the whole business, and runs a live teleprompter for meetings.

Founders: Kazel and Jamie are both repeat founders with buy-side finance experience. 
Kazel invented a new method of hacking with Softbank research funding at 17 and was recruited into Singapore's Intelligence Service.
Jamie was Chief of Staff at Openspace, a billion-dollar multi-asset manager, scaled revenue at Banyan Group one of Asia's largest hospitality players and is also a repeat founder.

They've known each other for over 5 years and previously worked together as the youngest Singapore defence contractors.

Collar: the category leader for investor relations
